_doc: INDIVIDUAL loot (owner 2026-11-23: no need/greed). Every corpse, chest or bag holds separate contents for each player who may open it, rolled the first time THAT player opens it (seeded by the container and the player, so the same player always sees the same roll). Gold is never added to anyone automatically — it sits in the window until taken. Items are Emberveil bases + Farhold affixes through rpg.loot.generate at an item level near the container's level; proficiency enchantments (proficiency.json `affixes`) can roll on magic-or-better armour and jewellery. js/rules/loot.js is the one reader. Tables by monster: `monsterTable` picks by rank then by family.
_rarityDoc: 2026-11-27 (owner: gear upgrades like D2): 60/30/9/1 -> 52/34/12/2 — more blues and yellows now that rarity means real power (loot-tables `power.enhanced`).

power._doc: Gear power (owner 2026-11-27: 'significantly better upgrades like d2'; report #142; docs/BRAINSTORM-2026-11-27-gear.md). js/rules/gear-power.js is the one reader; every item maker passes through it (js/rules/engine.js). A piece's damage / armour = its base x `quality` x (1 + perLevel x (item level - 1)) x (1 + enhanced). `enhanced` = D2's '+% enhanced damage': a share rolled per item inside its rarity's range (from the item's id, so it costs no loot roll). `quality` replaces Emberveil's 0.7-1.6 so a rare is never worse than the same white. `tiers`: the word put before the base name by item level and material (a Steel Longsword, Tanned Boots). `armourFromLevel`: a base starting with `prefix` below item level `from` is made as `else` instead (#143: plate from item level 4, where 13 Strength is usual). The hero's own weapon growth (attributes.json base.meleePerLevel) went to 0 the same day: the item carries it now.

kinds._doc: Which Emberveil base keys can drop, by kind. Bases with minAct > 2 or dragon parts are left out of round 1.
kinds._magicDoc: Magic weapons and off-hand foci (2026-11-24: Thousandvale's caster styles, js/rules/casters.js). A base listed twice comes up twice as often: a wand most, then a tome or an orb. The off-hand foci (Warded Focus, Rune Aegis, Spellguard Orb, Arcane Bulwark) add a rider to a wand, tome or sceptre.

grave_cache._doc: An open grave's small cache (Ashfield, owner 2026-11-27: 'easter eggs where you can loot certain open graves').

grave_ring._doc: The rare open grave with a ring in it.
